Investment Opportunity in Killeen, TX!! #realestateinvestment 

This well-established Italian sandwich and pizza restaurant has served the community for decades and is ready for its next owner! Conveniently located just off Fort Cavazos, this restaurant features indoor and outdoor dining and comes fully equipped for a seamless transition.
🔹 Fixtures & Equipment Included!
✅ 3 freezers & 4 refrigerators
✅ 2 pizza ovens, slicer, large mixer & more
✅ Misc. kitchen equipment for full operation
The property also includes two storage buildings in the fenced backyard, providing ample space for supplies. Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to own a well-known restaurant with a loyal customer base!
